args.summary:
Model built successfully and passed all L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks.

Structure: 2D spine-beam idealization (MR-01) of a five-span precast prestressed T-girder bridge (35+40+40+40+35 m), continuous in the finished state (structure.system = "continuous"; no pier column geometry given, so Pier 2 is modeled as bearings on a rigid support, MR-05).

Section/materials: t_girder middle girder, h=2.5 m, flange 1.80 m (tip 0.18 m → root 0.27 m), web 0.20 m, bulb 0.60 m. Integrated single-girder A = 1.022 m², I = 0.85655 m⁴; combined over 6 girders A = 6.132 m², I = 5.13933 m⁴ (MR-02). C50 concrete: Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5), γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1); girder self-weight only w = 159.43 kN/m, m = 16.25 t/m (MR-07).

Bearings: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric on abutments 0/5 and piers 1/3/4 (longitudinally free, Kh = 0), plain laminated fixed bearing on pier 2 (longitudinal spring). Six bearings per line (one per girder end). Bearing stiffness: a×b = 400×450 mm, te = 6×8 = 48 mm, S = 13.235, Kv = 14.449×10⁶ kN/m (JTG 3362-2018 8.7); Kh(pier 2) = 22500 kN/m.

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 4 design lanes (W = 15 m, Table 4.3.1-4), ξ = 0.67 (Table 4.3.1-5), qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 330 kN (35 m spans) / 340 kN (40 m spans) (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1). Fundamental vertical frequency f1 = 3.485 Hz → μ = 0.2049 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Key results: f1 = 3.485 Hz (next modes 4.172, 5.166 Hz); total self-weight support reactions sum ≈ 30.29 MN; max live-load positive moment 11.94 MN·m, max negative moment −9.61 MN·m.
